person_jobs.title: Owner
person_jobs.description: As a Freelance designer I've had the pleasure of helping companies of all sizes achieve their business goals through thoughtful visual design, user experience and product strategy.

person_jobs.title: Head of Product Design
person_jobs.description: Helping everyone understand contracts through the power of AI.

person_jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
person_jobs.description:
As the founding designer of Acre, I have been able to establish design guidelines and best practices from the beginning. Additionally, I have been heavily involved in various aspects of the company's development, which has been incredibly fulfilling. Witnessing the growth of the business, from its initial concept to acquiring real customers, has been a rewarding experience.

In my time at Acre I helped shape their core product from end to end. Collaborating with our Front End, Back End and Product Management teams I defined, wireframes and executed visual design for workflows like asset and income verification, home purchase journey, searching and filtering of qualified homes, and creating solutions to tell complex financial comparisons through easy to use calculators and pitch materials. 

Outside of this core product work I also laid the foundations for brand and future product work by establishing Acre's design system, screen libraries, illustration libraries and more.

person_jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
person_jobs.description:
In my role at Pendo, I collaborated with the executive team, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to develop innovative solutions in data analytics, onboarding, and guide delivery. 

I oversaw design and research for their flagship product, Visual Design Studio, and lead design for their newest product, Pendo Adopt, which provides in-app onboarding, workflow enhancements, and usage analytics to Pendo's customers' end-users.  I successfully built and scaled an MVP to a fully-realized product, driving significant revenue and shaping the vision and roadmap for their product.

Additionally, migrated the design team to Figma, improved front-end/design processes, and established a design system strategy, which enabled Pendo to scale and work more efficiently across all locations.

person_jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
person_jobs.description: At Viget, my role consists of designing detailed, responsive compositions for the web, requiring in-depth thinking around user experience and research before translating them to design. I work collaboratively with a team of back and front-end developers, user experience specialists, data team members and project managers to make award winning, high quality interactive products.

person_jobs.title: Designer
person_jobs.description: Responsibilities included: concept and initial sketches, brainstorming and ideation for large websites, designing comprehensive and organized photoshop documents to be passed to developers for implementation, icon, logo and various other asset design as well as general design consulting internally and client-side primarily for the web.

person_jobs.title: Associate Designer
person_jobs.location: Greater Minneapolis-St. Paul Area, + Brooklyn, NY
person_jobs.description:
Worked collaboratively with others to complete successful interactive campaigns that upheld strict brand guidelines. 

Clients: American Express, Dairy Queen, Optum Health and internal space150 projects.

person_jobs.title: Co-Founder, Designer
person_jobs.description:
City of Ash was a game produced by Monster Games (now Metamoki Inc.), and developed by myself and Brady Law. City of Ash was developed for the Facebook platform.

It's success, with a user base of over 160,000+ monthly active users in 2009 lead to the development of the Iphone version by Ayogo Games.
